rule: Durations the sources state are used as stated. Where they are silent: a revolving beam lasts 0.3 of the cycle (shared among its beams) and swells and fades; a flash lasts 2 s (1 s within a group); the dark between flashes of a group 2 s; an eclipse 3 s; the light between eclipses of a group 2 s; the long step fills the cycle, and where the long step is stated, the unstated gaps share what is left.
